selection_process: Shortlisted candidates will have to undergo an interview and any other selection criteria as deemed fit by the Management. how_to_apply: Fill in the application in the proforma given in Annexure-I (Employment Application Form) of the advertisement, preferably type written. Paste a passport size photo on it, sign the declaration and list the certificates you enclose.
Attach self-attested copies of certificates for educational qualification, age and experience.
Send the application through your Competent Authority. It must be duly forwarded along with the certificate in Annexure-II, filled in by the Cadre Controlling Authority.
Write "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF CHIEF GENERAL MANAGER" on the outer cover.
Send it by registered/speed post to: Joint General Manager (HR), Security Printing & Minting Corporation of India Ltd., 3rd Floor, Tower- G, World Trade Centre, Nauroji Nagar, New Delhi-110029.
Make sure the application reaches this address by 16 November 2026. Applications received after 16.11.2026 will not be entertained.

An advance copy of the application from an eligible candidate will be considered only if it is duly forwarded by the Cadre Controlling Authority before the interview. If it is not, the candidate will not be allowed to appear in the interview.
Application in the Annexure-I proforma, with a passport size photo
Self-attested copies of certificates for educational qualification, age and experience

Annexure-II certificate from the Cadre Controlling Authority. It certifies that the particulars have been checked and found correct, that the candidate is eligible, that no vigilance case is pending, that the officer's integrity is beyond doubt, that no Major/Minor penalties have been imposed in the last ten years, and that the candidate will be spared immediately to join if selected. It is signed with name, designation, office address with seal and telephone number.
Attested photocopies of the complete and up-to-date Annual Performance Appraisal Report and dossiers for the last 5 years, including 2024-25. The authority forwarding the application provides these.

The Annexure-I form asks for details including: graduation onwards education, experience starting from the latest employment (with pay matrix/IDA scale and duties), the nature and basis of present employment, total emoluments now drawn, any relative working with SPMCIL, computer knowledge, training in the last 5 years, and any pending criminal case or conviction.

content_sections.heading: About SPMCIL
content_sections.text: SPMCIL is a Schedule 'A' Mini-ratna Category-I Central Public Sector Enterprise wholly owned by the Government of India. It started functioning as a corporatized entity with effect from 13 January 2006. It designs and manufactures security papers and prints currency and bank notes, passports, non-judicial stamp papers and postage stamps, and it also mints coins. Its registered and corporate office is at 3rd Floor, Tower- G, World Trade Centre, Nauroji Nagar, New Delhi- 110029. Its operational units are four Mints at Mumbai, Kolkata, Hyderabad and Noida, four Currency / Security Presses at Nashik, Dewas and Hyderabad, and a Paper Manufacturing Mill at Narmadapuram.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The post is open to Officers/ Executives working in the Govt./PSUs/ Autonomous Bodies/ Statutory Bodies, for appointment as CGM in SPMCIL on deputation basis. First class B.Tech /B.E. in Electrical/ Mechanical / Metallurgical /Electronic Engineering/ Printing Technology/ Chemical Engineering/ Pulp and Paper Technology from a recognized University. Govt. Officers holding analogous post on regular basis in Pay level 14 in pay matrix revised as per 7th Pay Commission, and PSU Executives in IDA pay scale of Rs.1,20,000-2,80,000/- (revised as per 3rd PRC); OR Officers with 3 years of regular service in the Govt. in pay level 13 in pay matrix as per 7th CPC; OR PSU executives having 20 years of post-qualification experience, out of which 2 years regular service at E-7 level in the IDA pay scale of Rs.1,00,000-2,60,000/-. The maximum age is 56 years as on 16 November 2026. Age is reckoned as on 16 November 2026. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Level and pay: E-8. Pay level 14 of the Matrix as per the 7th CPC, OR Rs.1,20,000-2,80,000/- (IDA) for PSU Executives or equivalent. Pay fixation and benefits: The pay fixation and other benefits of the selected candidates will be regulated as per the prevalent rules of DoPT/ DPE. The notice does not list any separate allowances. Nature and term: Deputation basis, initially for a period of 3 years, with further extension as per Govt. of India Rules. Posting and transfer: Chief General Managers are liable for transfer all over SPMCIL units and HQ, depending on the operational priority and functional requirement. The selected candidate is liable to be posted in any of the Units or the Corporate Office of SPMCIL as per requirement. Panel: The panel is formed to keep a bench strength of Unit/ Technical Heads available in SPMCIL.

content_sections.heading: SPMCIL Chief General Manager Job Description
content_sections.text: Chief General Managers head the Units and report to the Directors and CMD. The Units are accountable for work-place efficiency, for making the best use of available resources, and for meeting the production and sales targets set in the MOU commitment with the Government.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in SPMCIL Recruitment 2026 for Chief General Manager?
faq.answer: Advt.No. 06/2026 advertises 4 (Four) posts of Chief General Manager, Level E-8, on deputation basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the SPMCIL Chief General Manager post?
faq.answer: The application must reach SPMCIL by registered/speed post by 16 November 2026. Applications received after 16.11.2026 will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the SPMCIL Chief General Manager post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a first class B.Tech/B.E. in Electrical, Mechanical, Metallurgical or Electronic Engineering, Printing Technology, Chemical Engineering, or Pulp and Paper Technology from a recognized University. They also need one of the three experience routes printed in the notice.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the SPMCIL Chief General Manager post?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years as on 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the SPMCIL Chief General Manager?
faq.answer: The post carries Pay level 14 of the Matrix as per the 7th CPC, or Rs.1,20,000-2,80,000/- (IDA) for PSU Executives or equivalent. Pay fixation and other benefits are regulated as per the prevalent rules of DoPT/DPE.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the SPMCIL Chief General Manager post?
faq.answer: Fill in the Annexure-I proforma and attach self-attested certificates. Have it forwarded by your Competent Authority with the Annexure-II certificate. Send it by registered/speed post to the Joint General Manager (HR), SPMCIL, 3rd Floor, Tower- G, World Trade Centre, Nauroji Nagar, New Delhi-110029.

faq.question: Q7. What should be written on the envelope?
faq.answer: The outer cover should be marked "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF CHIEF GENERAL MANAGER".

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the SPMCIL Chief General Manager post?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will have to undergo an interview and any other selection criteria as deemed fit by the Management. The Management may raise the eligibility criteria to limit the number of candidates called for interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is the SPMCIL Chief General Manager post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The post is on deputation basis, initially for a period of 3 years, with further extension as per Govt. of India Rules.

faq.question: Q10. Will SPMCIL pay travel costs for the interview?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates called for interview will be reimbursed Air fare in the Economy Class to the place of interview on production of proof of tickets.
